name: Same Network / Valid Address Check
recognitionClueHinglish: Do ya teen IPs aur mask; kaunse same network me hain ya kaunsa address is subnet ka ho sakta hai.
generalSolvingApproach: 2. Har address ka network id nikaalo.
variationsObserved: Mask ke saath 'kaunsa value network me nahi jaana chahiye'.
commonTraps: Sirf last octet compare karna jab mask beech me hai.

name: Hosts per Subnet / Number of Subnets
recognitionClueHinglish: Class/network, mask ya subnet bits di hain; max hosts ya subnets poochhe hain; last host address.
variationsObserved: Subnet mask for a required number of subnets.

name: CIDR Allocation and Aggregation
recognitionClueHinglish: ISP ka block kai organizations me baantna, ya routing-table prefixes ko aggregate karna.
generalSolvingApproach: 1. Size ko power of 2 me round up.
variationsObserved: Kai subnets ko ek prefix me aggregate.

name: Routing Table Lookup / Longest Prefix Match
recognitionClueHinglish: Routing/forwarding table aur destination address diya hai; kis interface/next hop par jaayega.
generalSolvingApproach: 1. Har entry ke mask se dest AND karo.
2. Jo network id se match kare unhe shortlist karo.
3. Sabse bada prefix chuno; default last.
